en: The front of the postcard features a black and white studio photograph of a man dressed as a comedic or theatrical character, with a bowler hat, striped shirt, and mismatched shoes, holding a long stick and a flower in his lapel. Large handwriting, presumably an autograph, is seen across the bottom. Text in the bottom corners reads "ALEXANDER GIRARDT als Robert (aus Robert u. Bertram)." and "HAHN NACHF., Dresden 1910." The reverse side contains handwritten text in German, a postage stamp, and a postmark from Dresden.
